rungs.title: Deputy Director (SCS1)
rungs.summary: Leads a large team or function and is accountable to a director for its results.
rungs.knowledge: Brings strategic understanding of a whole area and keeps it current with government priorities.
rungs.delivery: Owns a significant budget and set of outcomes and answers for them.
rungs.leadership: Leads grade 6 managers, builds a leadership team and represents the area to senior stakeholders.

rungs.title: Director (SCS2)
rungs.summary: Leads a major function or several teams and sets direction for it.
rungs.knowledge: Sees across the department and government, and shapes how the area contributes to the department's aims.
rungs.delivery: Is accountable for major programmes or services and their value for money.
rungs.leadership: Leads deputy directors, works closely with ministers' offices and the board, and builds the culture.

rungs.title: Director General (SCS3)
rungs.summary: Leads a large part of the department and sits on its senior board.
rungs.knowledge: Sets and explains strategy for a whole group and links it to the department's aims.
rungs.delivery: Is accountable for a large budget and for the department's performance in their area.
rungs.leadership: Leads directors, advises ministers directly and represents the department across government.
